where: satbank/topics/linear_equations_in_two_variables/families/solve.py, context_substitute, the d.get("speeds") mistakes list (ctx 2, Cameron's drive)
what: "gave the second speed as the number of hours" (A) and "gave the first speed" (B) are bare guesses listed before the computed routes. gridin_mistakes keeps the first reason for each value. Whenever y=1, the miles left (C-B*g) equal A, so a student who stopped at the miles left (seed 38: 370-300=70) is told they gave the second speed as the number of hours. Whenever x=1, the miles driven (B*g) equal B, so a student who computed the first leg is told they gave the first speed. This includes the official item 2.2, where 60 is named "gave the first speed". That is 224 plus 280 of the 1120 drive draws. A student asked for hours rarely types a speed without doing any arithmetic, so the entries are doubtful on their own as well.
fix: Drop the two bare-speed entries (A, B) from the speeds list, or at least move them after "gave the miles left rather than the hours they take", "gave the miles driven at the first speed" and the C/A entry, so the computed route names the shared value.
